# Subhasish Adhikary

> Growth marketing and GTM strategist specializing in B2B go-to-market strategy, marketing automation, GTM engineering, and AI marketing. This website provides GTM intelligence tools, B2B marketing tool stacks, a comprehensive marketing glossary, and strategic marketing articles.

## About

## GTM Intelligence Tool

https://subhasishadhikary.com/#/tools/gtm-intelligence

Interactive GTM intelligence tool that helps B2B companies build go-to-market strategies. Users provide inputs about their company stage, product, target market, and resources. The tool outputs a complete GTM strategy including ICP definition, positioning, messaging framework, channel strategy, and implementation roadmap.

## GTM Stack

https://subhasishadhikary.com/#/gtm-stack

Interactive GTM stack visualization showing how different marketing technologies connect across the GTM motion. Users can explore how tools integrate across awareness, consideration, decision, and retention stages.
